import csv, os, sys
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP

def find_input():
    best=None
    best_rows=0
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk('/workspace'):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
        for name in files:
            if not name.lower().endswith('.csv') or name == 'totals.csv':
                continue
            path=os.path.join(root,name)
            try:
                with open(path, newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as fh:
                    reader=csv.reader(fh)
                    header=None
                    rows=0
                    for row in reader:
                        if not row:
                            continue
                        if header is None:
                            cleaned=[h.strip().lower() for h in row]
                            if 'category' in cleaned and 'amount_usd' in cleaned:
                                header=row
                                rows=1
                            continue
                        rows += 1
                if header is not None:
                    if rows > best_rows:
                        best_rows=rows
                        best=path
            except Exception:
                pass
    return best

path=find_input()
if not path:
    sys.exit(1)

totals={}
with open(path, newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as fh:
    reader=csv.reader(fh)
    cat_idx=amt_idx=None
    for row in reader:
        if not row:
            continue
        cleaned=[h.strip().lower() for h in row]
        if 'category' in cleaned and 'amount_usd' in cleaned:
            cat_idx=cleaned.index('category')
            amt_idx=cleaned.index('amount_usd')
            break
    if cat_idx is None or amt_idx is None:
        sys.exit(1)
    for row in reader:
        if len(row) <= max(cat_idx, amt_idx):
            continue
        cat=row[cat_idx].strip()
        amt=row[amt_idx].strip()
        if not cat:
            continue
        amt=amt.replace(',', '').replace('$', '').replace(' ', '').replace('\xa0', '')
        try:
            val=Decimal(amt)
        except InvalidOperation:
            continue
        totals[cat]=totals.get(cat, Decimal('0')) + val

with open('/workspace/totals.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as out:
    writer=csv.writer(out)
    writer.writerow(['category','total_usd'])
    q=Decimal('0.01')
    for cat, val in sorted(totals.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])):
        writer.writerow([cat, str(val.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))])
PY
</solution>

<solution verdict="run">
python3 - <<'PY'
import tarfile, io, re
src = tarfile.open('/workspace/archive.tar', 'r')
members = src.getmembers()
target = None
for m in members:
    if m.name == 'config.ini' or m.name == './config.ini':
        target = m
        break
out = tarfile.open('/workspace/new.tar', 'w')
mode_re = re.compile(rb'^\s*mode\s*=\s*[^\s]*')
for m in members:
    if target is not None and m is target:
        f = src.extractfile(m)
        if f is None:
            out.addfile(m)
            continue
        data = f.read()
        lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
        new_lines = []
        replaced = False
        for line in lines:
            if mode_re.match(line):
                new_line = mode_re.sub(b'mode=prod', line)
                new_lines.append(new_line)
                replaced = True
            else:
                new_lines.append(line)
        if not replaced:
            if lines:
                last = lines[-1]
                if not last.endswith(b'\n') and not last.endswith(b'\r\n'):
                    new_lines.append(b'\n')
            new_lines.append(b'mode=prod\n')
        new_data = b''.join(new_lines)
        tm = m.copy()
        tm.size = len(new_data)
        out.addfile(tm, io.BytesIO(new_data))
    else:
        f = src.extractfile(m)
        if f is None:
            out.addfile(m)
        else:
            out.addfile(m, io.BytesIO(f.read()))
out.close()
src.close()

    info.gid = m.gid
    info.uname = m.uname
    info.gname = m.gname
    info.type = m.type
    info.linkname = m.linkname
    info.device_type = m.device_type
    info.devmajor = m.devmajor
    info.devminor = m.devminor

def modify_config(data):
    pattern = re.compile(rb'^[ \t]*mode[ \t]*=[ \t]*.*', re.M)
    # Need preserve line endings. Use splitlines.
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out=[]
    replaced=False

        match = re.match(rb'^[ \t]*mode[ \t]*=[ \t]*(.*)', line)
        if match:
            if line.endswith(b'\r\n'):
                end = b'\r\n'
            elif line.endswith(b'\n'):
                end = b'\n'
            else:

            out.append(b'mode=prod' + end)
            replaced=True

        out.append(b'mode=prod\n')
    return b''.join(out)

    info.uname = m.uname

def modify_config(data):
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    replaced = False
    for line in lines:
        match = re.match(rb'^[ \t]*mode[ \t]*=[ \t]*(.*)', line)

import tarfile, io, re, os

src = '/workspace/archive.tar'
dst = '/workspace/new.tar'

def copy_info(m):
    info = tarfile.TarInfo(m.name)
    info.mtime = m.mtime
    info.mode = m.mode
    info.uid = m.uid
    info.gid = m.gid
    info.uname = m.uname
    info.gname = m.gname
    info.type = m.type
    info.linkname = m.linkname
    info.device_type = m.device_type
    info.devmajor = m.devmajor
    info.devminor = m.devminor
    info.pax_headers = dict(m.pax_headers)
    info.pax_headers.pop('size', None)
    return info

def modify_config(data):
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    replaced = False
    for line in lines:
        if re.match(rb'^[ \t]*mode[ \t]*=[ \t]*', line):
            if line.endswith(b'\r\n'):
                end = b'\r\n'
            elif line.endswith(b'\n'):
                end = b'\n'
            elif line.endswith(b'\r'):
                end = b'\r'
            else:
                end = b''
            out.append(b'mode=prod' + end)
            replaced = True
        else:
            out.append(line)
    if not replaced:
        if lines:
            last = lines[-1]
            if not last.endswith(b'\n') and not last.endswith(b'\r\n') and not last.endswith(b'\r'):
                out[-1] += b'\n'
        out.append(b'mode=prod\n')
    return b''.join(out)

with tarfile.open(src, 'r') as tin:
    members = tin.getmembers()
    selected = None
    exact_names = {'config.ini', './config.ini'}
    for i, m in enumerate(members):
        if m.isreg() and (m.name in exact_names or os.path.basename(m.name) == 'config.ini'):
            if m.name in exact_names:
                selected = i
                break
            if selected is None:
                selected = i
    if selected is None:
        raise SystemExit('config.ini not found in archive')
    with tarfile.open(dst, 'w', format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT) as tout:
        for i, m in enumerate(members):
            if i == selected and m.isreg():
                data = tin.extractfile(m).read()
                newdata = modify_config(data)
                info = copy_info(m)
                info.size = len(newdata)
                tout.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(newdata))
            elif m.isreg():
                data = tin.extractfile(m).read()
                info = copy_info(m)
                info.size = len(data)
                tout.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
            else:
                info = copy_info(m)
                tout.addfile(info)

```
def transform(data):
    if b'mode=prod' in data:
        return data
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    pattern = re.compile(rb'^(?P<prefix>[ \t]*mode=)(?P<value>[^\n\r]*)(?P<end>\r?\n?)')
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        m = pattern.match(line)
        if m:
            trailing = m.group('value')[len(m.group('value').rstrip(b' \t')):]
            lines[i] = m.group('prefix') + b'prod' + trailing + m.group('end')
            return b''.join(lines)
    if not data:
        return b'mode=prod\n'
    if not data.endswith(b'\n'):
        return data + b'\nmode=prod\n'
    return data + b'mode=prod\n'
```
